title: newchat CWD guard: skip /clear if hwnd not in FindAllAiConsolesByCwd result
desc: newchat injected /clear into wrong terminals when multiple Claude Code sessions shared CWD. All strategies now cross-check hwnd against FindAllAiConsolesByCwd result before injecting.
steps: 1. Pre-build cwdCandidates=FindAllAiConsolesByCwd(projectCwd). 2. Strategy-0 CallerHwnd: skip if not in cwdCandidates. 3. Strategy-1 FindOwnTerminal: skip if not in cwdCandidates. 4. Strategy-2: iterate cwdCandidates with DoCliInject. 5. Empty cwdCandidates = no /clear sent.
author: claude
